Item 1. Business
We design and manufacture widgets. For a discussion of the risks affecting our business, see Item 1A. Risk Factors below. BUSINESSSECTIONMARKER our operations span forty states and our workforce exceeds ten thousand employees, and our manufacturing footprint is described throughout this business section.
Our revenue is earned across three operating segments described in this Item 1, none of which should be confused with the risk disclosures that follow later.
Item 1A. Risk Factors
The following risk factors could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations. You should consider them carefully.
We depend on a small number of large customers, and the loss of any of them would materially harm our operating results.
A significant portion of our revenue comes from a few large customers, as noted elsewhere in this Item 1A. If we lose one of them, or if such a customer materially reduces its purchases, our operating results would be materially and adversely affected over the following periods.
Substantial doubt may exist about our ability to continue as a going concern.
Our recurring losses from operations and negative cash flows raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern within one year, absent additional capital that we may be unable to raise on acceptable terms.
Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments
None.
